set.now: verified headless, matches the live log; writing docs and landing
steps: read asks.js, ai.css, doc/asks.md, doc/task-jsonl.md, the run task's conclusion lines, report-order and reply-in-place landings

set.outcome:
**An ask's `conclusion` now leads.** Once the mastermind has weighed an ask and written down its answer, that one plain sentence becomes the card's title — the question that prompted it (`summary`) moves one click down into the sheet, under a small "you asked" label, right above the verbatim quote. An ask with nothing concluded on it yet renders exactly as it always did: id-derived title, summary right on the card. An optional `minutes` shows as a quiet `~N min` beside the status chip only on the rare card that will take the owner longer than a glance — most cards say nothing there. The wall's own head now reads "conclusions first" beside its counts.

![the layout-browser ask, titled by its conclusion, sheet open with "you asked"](conclusions-first-1280.png)

Verified headless on a private server (port 8135, killed by its real Windows PID at the end): on the real run task, **65 asks are live right now, 34 carrying a conclusion and 31 not** — a fresh read of the raw log and the rendered DOM agree on both numbers, at 400, 1280 and 1920, with zero console errors and zero horizontal overflow at all three. Clicking a conclusion-titled card opens the sheet with "you asked" and the right sentence. report-order's band/fold/rank machinery and reply-in-place's reply/mic buttons and dictate box all still render and work — checked in the same run, not assumed.

[the run task, conclusions first](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/mastermind-layout-browser/) · [doc/asks.md](/framework/ext/AITask/doc/asks/) ("Conclusions first") · [doc/task-jsonl.md](/framework/ext/JSONL/doc/task-jsonl/) (`conclusion`/`minutes` beside the `ask` verb) · [ext/AITask](/framework/ext/AITask/)

**Left, and why.** The brief's "the band head's line" could mean the wall's own head (printed once) or each topic band's own heading (printed once per band) — I chose the wall's head, since it is the one truly singular line and keeps the cap of one short label; logged as a `decision` the owner can Improve if that read it wrong. The "you asked" block only appears on a sheet whose card carries a conclusion, so the 31 not-yet-concluded asks are untouched top to bottom, per the brief's own word for them.
